headline: 大娛樂家音樂劇登西區
context: 改編自電影《大娛樂家》（The Greatest Showman）的音樂劇，明年春天要在倫敦西區的皇家劇院（Theatre Royal Drury Lane）上演。這齣迪士尼製作今年稍早已在布里斯托完售八週演出，男女主角奧利佛・湯普賽特與莎曼珊・巴克斯，屆時將回歸原班角色。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Disney production ran in Bristol earlier this year and its stars Oliver Tompsett and Samantha Barks will resume their roles at Theatre Royal Drury Lane The Greatest Showman, the 2017 Hugh Jackman film with a chart-topping soundtrack, is to be staged in the West End next spring . After a sellout eight-week run at Bristol Hippodrome earlier this year, the Disney musical will arrive at the Theatre Royal Drury Lane, currently home to Disney’s Hercules. Its Bristol stars, Oliver Tompsett and Samantha Barks, will resume their respective roles as circus entrepreneur PT Barnum and his wife, Charity. Barks previously starred at Drury Lane as Elsa in Disney’s stage version of Frozen . Also returning from the Bristol production are Ben Joyce (as Barnum’s associate Phillip Carlyle), Vajèn van den Bosch (as opera singer Jenny Lind, known as the “Swedish nightingale”) and Malinda Parris (as the “bearded lady” Lettie Lutz). thread_text:
改編自電影《大娛樂家》（The Greatest Showman）的音樂劇，明年春天要在倫敦西區的皇家劇院（Theatre Royal Drury Lane）上演。

這齣迪士尼製作今年稍早已在布里斯托完售八週演出，男女主角奧利佛・湯普賽特（Oliver Tompsett）與莎曼珊・巴克斯（Samantha Barks），屆時將回歸原班角色。

目前這則消息只有 The Guardian 一家報導，細節有限。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 15 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 電影《大娛樂家》要變成舞台音樂劇了。明年春天，倫敦西區的皇家劇院會推出這齣改編音樂劇。這個迪士尼製作，今年稍早已經在布里斯托完售八週演出，男女主角奧利佛・湯普賽特和莎曼珊・巴克斯，屆時會回歸原本的角色。目前的消息細節還有限。
